title: Joint q-Numerical Ranges of Continuous Operator-Valued Functions
summary: This paper develops a unified theory of joint $q$-numerical ranges $\Fq(F)$ for continuous functions $F:\Om \to \B(\cH)$, where $\Om$ is a compact Hausdorff space and $\B(\cH)$ denotes the $C^*$-algebra of bounded linear operators on a complex Hilbert space $\cH$. We prove that $\Fq(F)$ is totally bounded in $\cC(\Om)$, the space of continuous complex-valued functions on $\Om$, and establish the upper semicontinuity of the set-valued map $F\mapsto \Fq(F)$, and show that $\Fq(F)$ is compact when $\cH$ is finite-dimensional.
